headline: CHEST November 2026 issue covers bronchoscopy waste and balloon pulmonary angioplasty
dek: Editor in Chief Dr Peter Mazzone highlights studies in the November 2026 issue of the journal CHEST, according to a post from the official CHEST account on X.
body:
Dr Peter Mazzone, Editor in Chief of the journal CHEST, has highlighted key research from the journal's November 2026 issue, according to a post on X from the official CHEST account of the American College of Chest Physicians.

The post said the issue includes an investigation into cutting waste in bronchoscopy. It also lists an examination of the effect of pretreatment with mono or dual pulmonary hypertension-targeted medical therapy on complications and clinical outcomes in patients undergoing balloon pulmonary angioplasty. The post said the issue contains further research as well, but did not name it.

The post does not report findings, study designs, sample sizes or author names for any of the work mentioned. It directs readers to a link under the words "Listen now", which suggests Dr Mazzone's highlights are available in audio form. Full details of the studies are in the November 2026 issue of CHEST.

The post carried hashtags including #JournalCHEST, #Pulmonology, #LungHealth, #Asthma and #COPD.
key_quote: an investigation into cutting waste in bronchoscopy
